title: Young Child in Hooded Coat by Tree, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot photograph featuring a young child dressed in a cozy hooded coat, trousers, and shoes, standing proudly beside a bare sapling on a residential lawn. In the background, a multi-story brick building with distinct architectural rooflines is visible. The physical photo exhibits classic deckle edges characteristic of 1940s domestic family snapshots.
